title: Funding Rate Settlement Frequency of USDⓈ-M GASUSDT and ORCAUSDT Perpetual Contracts Will Be Resumed (2025-04-16)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will resume the funding rate settlement frequency of the USDⓈ-M GASUSDT and ORCAUSDT Perpetual Contracts from every two hours to  every four hours  starting from  2025-04-16 12:00 (UTC) . The detailed arrangement is as follows: Time Max Funding Rate 2025-04-16 12:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-04-16 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-04-16 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-04-17 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … For More Information: Updates on Funding Rate Settlement Frequency of USDⓈ-M TROYUSDT and GASUSDT Perpetual Contracts (2025-04-10) Updates on Funding Rate Settlement Frequency of USDⓈ-M ORCAUSDT Perpetual Contract (2025-04-12) Introduction to Binance Futures Funding Rates Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-16
